name: Cinnamon Apple & Banana Oatmeal Protein Bites
ingredients: vanilla whey-based protein powder (containing 20 grams protein/serving)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two baking sheet pans with parchment paper.
Peel bananas, break into chunks, and place in a medium bowl. Mash with a fork or potato masher until smooth.
Add eggs and maple syrup to the bowl with the banana. Stir to combine.
Wash, dry, quarter, core, and small dice apple. Add to the bowl along with oats, protein powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir once more to combine the batter.

Using a ¼-cup measure, scoop batter onto the baking sheets, leaving some space between. Use the back of a spoon to spread each "bite" into a 3-inch circle. Place in the oven and bake until just firm to the touch, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Allow to cool for a few minutes before transferring to plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
